intent: Extend repository-backed continuity and capability governance with a bounded remote-only worker cursor, automatic next-invocation interruption recovery, turn-boundary S+H, and typed cross-workstream delivery contracts.
rationale_summary: CAP-0009 already owns bounded fresh-Agent recovery and live-head reconciliation; CAP-0010 already owns sparse governance routing and semantic-owner uniqueness. The observed worker interruption and ownership gaps fit their extension seams and do not require a new semantic owner.
